verdict.rationale:
Semgrep is fundamentally a CLI/rule-based SAST tool; there's no documented natural-language command interface for the core product. The only relevant hook is a documented MCP server (semgrep-probe-3) which would let an AI agent invoke Semgrep via natural language, plus marketing mentions of 'AI reasoning' combined with rule-based detection (semgrep-docs-47/48), but no detail on what commands/actions are exposed or how they map from NL input.
missing for 10: documented list of MCP tools/actions, evidence of actual natural-language command usage, hands-on confirmation that AI-native NL control works end-to-end.
